tools.name: recommend_bottles
tools.description: Recommend real bottles for a plain-language request: a dish, an occasion, a grape, a region or a budget (e.g. 'a red for lasagna under $40', 'Italian sparkling for a party'). Returns a short grounded answer and the bottles with their lowest current shop price and page link.

tools.name: search_bottles
tools.description: Search the Red Good Wine index of wine, beer, spirits and zero-proof bottles from independent US shops by name, producer, grape, region or style, optionally by category, style and a maximum price.

tools.name: bottle_offers
tools.description: Every shop that lists one bottle, cheapest in stock first, with price, stock, the US states the shop ships alcohol to (when known) and a link. Pass the bottle's Red Good Wine slug or page URL (from search_bottles or recommend_bottles).

tools.name: best_price
tools.description: Find a bottle by name and return its lowest current in-stock price across independent shops, with the shop and a link.

tools.name: price_index
tools.description: The Red Good Wine Price Index: how many shops and bottles are tracked, the median saving from shopping around, and today's biggest price gaps between shops for the same bottle.

tools.name: wine_pairing
tools.description: What wine to drink with a dish, with the classic grapes and real bottles to buy. Known dishes have a full page: seafood, oysters, steak, burgers, barbecue, pasta, pizza, lasagna, salmon, chicken, turkey, pork, cheese, charcuterie, spicy-food, thai-food, mushrooms, risotto, salad, vegetarian, dessert

tools.name: ships_to
tools.description: How buying works for a US state: Red Good Wine's own non-alcohol products ship within the US; wine, beer and spirits are sold and shipped by the licensed shops, each deciding where it ships (bottle_offers lists each shop's states when known).
